result.title: Speedrunning Relational Foundation Model Pretraining
authors: Gabriel Wedson Mendonça de Souza Veloso
result.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the CODEC-FM Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
result.summary: Progress on foundation model pretraining is gated by who can afford a trial, and relational pretraining is no exception. Recipes are developed inside individual labs, reported under private protocols, and do not accumulate. Speedrun leaderboards remove that barrier by decentralizing the search rather than the training run. The problem is fixed, the stack is open, entries are ranked by wall-clock time to a quality target, and one GPU is enough to hold the record. We introduce modded-nanoRT, the first such leaderboard for Relational Transformers. Which database to hold out decides whether the benchmark can resolve improvements at all, so we fix it by calibration, ranking six candidates by how sharply a 45-minute learning curve separates improvement from seed noise. We open the leaderboard with typed trilinear attention, a relational operator that conditions attention scores and values on the foreign key traversed, together with Muon and SIGReg. The recipe reaches the target in 305.63 seconds on one NVIDIA H200, 8.11x faster than the reference implementation, and wins 13 of 15 pairs outside the development database. We will release the benchmark, its frozen artifacts, and the record runs. Our code is available at https://github.com/kunumi/nanoRT.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出首个 Relational Transformer 预训练「速通」排行榜 modded-nanoRT，先经校准选定留出数据库，再以 typed trilinear attention、Muon 与 SIGReg 的组合在单张 H200 上 305.63 秒达到质量目标，比参考实现快 8.11 倍。
AI.relevance_reason: typed trilinear attention 将遍历到的外键关系类型注入注意力分数与 value，可供核查其是否能作为多模态 latent 状态中保留实体关系的设计线索；但论文核心是预训练效率基准与协议，与 LVR 推理期状态使用相距较远。
